name: references-motion-lesson
description: Kazakh educational motion-design video: working with references in AI video generation (9:16, 1080x1920).

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i build/video.mp4 -i build/mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart -shortest output/referencetermen-zhumys.mp4
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run audio && mkdir -p output && npm run mux
